title: Yield App publicly launches
description: Yield App opened public registrations and launched its digital asset wealth platform after an early-access period.
notes: Launch date is supported by Yield App's own public-launch announcement.

title: Yield App suspends all platform activity
description: Yield App announced the immediate suspension of all activity on the platform as it prepared to enter liquidation proceedings, citing portfolio losses connected to third-party hedge fund managers that had held assets on FTX.
notes: The suspension preceded the formal effective date of liquidation by several days.

title: Yield App enters insolvent liquidation
description: Yield App Limited entered insolvent liquidation and Stephen Cork and Hadley Chilton of Cork Gully LLP were appointed joint liquidators.
notes: Liquidation is recorded under restructuring_started because the event taxonomy has no dedicated liquidation-start enum; the platform status remains operations_ended.
